walkthroughs.body_html:
Fine Art (Drawing, Painting, Printmaking, Sculpture) — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Fine Art (Drawing, Painting, Printmaking, Sculpture) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Fine Art (Drawing, Painting, Printmaking, Sculpture).

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which fine art process produces multiple copies of one image?
options: Printmaking
Impasto painting
Gesture drawing
Carved sculpture

mcqs.q: Carving is called a subtractive sculpture process because:
options: Material is removed to reveal the form.
Material is added in layers.
Metal is poured into a mould.
Pieces are joined by welding.
A type of printing ink.
Paint applied so thickly that marks stand off the surface.
Thin transparent layers of paint.
Dots of pure colour.

mcqs.q: Lino printing belongs to which family of printmaking?
options: Stencil
Relief
Intaglio
Planographic

mcqs.q: Why does a lino print come out reversed?
options: The block mirrors the design, so the printed image is flipped left-to-right.
The paper stretches during printing.
The image prints exactly as drawn on the block.
No — sculpture is any flat artwork with texture.

mcqs.q: Is sculpture only made by carving?
options: Yes — real sculpture is always carved from stone or wood.
The paper stretches during printing.
No — sculpture is any flat artwork with texture.
No — sculpture can also be modelled, cast or constructed, as well as carved.

mcqs.q: How do you make a colour lighter in watercolour?
options: Add white paint, as you would with acrylics or oils.
Add a small amount of black paint.
Add more water so the white of the paper shows through the thinner wash.
No — sculpture is any flat artwork with texture.
